kernel.description: Synthetic Q8 head, one matrix per shape, all modes in one binary. Verify every output bit before timing. Compare ratios within each of six rounds.

model_cases.description: Only the final Q8 head varies. With one session all modes use the reference. Prefill with two sessions already selects two final head rows, so it also exercises each variant. Reject bit, prompt, KV or workspace disagreement. Retain every timing and per-head interval.

comparison: Six rotations of mode_order_seed balance position and preceding mode. Compare within-round ratios of average head and full decode times per call, then take the median of the six ratios. The same-function control estimates timing variation.
advance: A candidate needs a full-shape synthetic median ratio <=0.95, model two-session decode head median ratio <=0.90 with at least five of six pairs below one, model two-session full decode median ratio <=0.99, and prefill and one-session decode median ratios <=1.05. All six same-path model total/decode or head comparison medians used for gating must be within [0.95, 1.05]. Passing this screen permits separate ordinary-runtime confirmation.
